# NoSleep — Comprehensive Technical & Architectural Documentation

## Executive Overview
NoSleep (https://nosleeppage.com) is an ambient web application engineered to solve display sleep timeout frustrations without requiring native software installation. It combines the W3C Screen Wake Lock API, in-memory Web Audio API procedural synthesis, and adaptive Canvas 2D/WebGL rendering into a single, cohesive, client-side digital space.

## Technical Architecture

### 1. Screen Wake Lock API
NoSleep uses `navigator.wakeLock.request('screen')`.
- State Tracking: Tracks 'idle', 'requesting', 'active', 'released', 'unsupported', and 'error'.
- Automatic Reacquisition: When the tab visibility state changes from hidden to visible (`document.visibilityState === 'visible'`), NoSleep automatically re-acquires the sentinel.
- Security Model: Operates on HTTPS only. Does not require hardware permissions.

### 2. Audio Engine (Web Audio API)
- Pure Procedural Synthesis: Brown noise (integrated -6 dB/octave Brownian motion), filtered pink noise for rainfall, LFO-modulated lowpass noise for ocean surf, and harmonic oscillators for Rhodes electric piano chords.
- Zero Bandwidth / Zero Clicks: Audio runs via in-memory Web Audio graphs with clickless looping and exponential crossfades.
- 100% Offline Capable: Does not rely on streaming servers.

### 3. Visual Engine (Adaptive Canvas 2D)
- Breathing Orb: 4-7-8 breathing cadence with soft radial gradient and pulsing ripples.
- Particle Universe: Interactive floating cosmic dust particles reacting to mouse and touch.
- Orbital Atoms: Planetary orbits revolving in harmonic mathematical ratios.
- Battery Conservation: Automatically halts all `requestAnimationFrame` loops when `document.hidden === true` (0% CPU/GPU overhead when minimized).

### 4. Privacy & Data Handling
- 100% Client-side.
- Zero analytics cookies or tracking pixels.
- Zero backend databases or serverless functions.
- LocalStorage schema version 1 for user themes, master volumes, and custom presets.

### 5. Multi-Language Support (i18n)
- 7 Fully Localized Static Languages: English (en), Spanish (es), German (de), French (fr), Portuguese (pt), Japanese (ja), Simplified Chinese (zh).
- Reciprocal hreflang tags on all routes with x-default pointing to root.

### 6. Specialized Workflows & Solution Routes
- [Prevent Screen Sleep](https://nosleeppage.com/prevent-screen-sleep/): Zero-install utility to prevent display dimming, screensavers, and sleep mode on Windows 11, macOS, and mobile devices.
- [AI Agents & Long Prompts](https://nosleeppage.com/for/ai-agents/): Prevents operating system sleep, App Nap, and WebSocket dropouts while running autonomous AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor Composer, Devin, Antigravity) and local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio).
- [Work Laptops & Zero Admin](https://nosleeppage.com/for/work-laptops/): 100% IT-compliant browser sandbox wake lock for enterprise laptops with locked screensaver and sleep timeout policies.
- [Developer Workstations](https://nosleeppage.com/for/developers/): Keeps compilers, Docker builds, and database migrations running without native CLI tools.
